udfd1602dd2: Custom UART command configuration in DUT command mode
u2132b55f39: When DUT command mode is enabled and the "UART command configuration" (串口命令配置) is empty, the test box sends the original CMD_BOX_ENTER_DUT(0x04) command. By default, the SDK responds to this command by entering the DUT test state and waiting for a connection.
u7d61e90c3f: If the UART command configuration contains custom content (up to 31 bytes of hexadecimal values), the test box sends a command starting with CMD_BOX_CUSTOM_CODE(0xF0); for example, if you enter 00, the test box sends the command F0 00, which the SDK by default handles by entering quick self-test mode. You can change the content of the command configuration and add a response to the command in the SDK to implement specific functions.
uf767a7e60f: DUT command mode is mutually exclusive with upgrade, pairing and testing in UART mode; they cannot be used at the same time.
